title: Instruction robustness across three encounter families
scope: Prespecified extension; all combinations retained; no production library import
interpretation: Known initial states, no wind, instructed A holds target even for zero turn; B holds 045. No route turn is silently included. Uncertainty bounds and rate are illustrative. Tied left/right minima remain ties. Unresolved is not conflict. Main computation uses 80 digits; repeat every query at 120 and require agreement. The 25m band is numerical exclusion, not operational extra separation. No probabilities or fuel/workload claims.
